He is the recipient of numerous awards, including four National Film Awards and eight Filmfare Awards, as well as an Academy Award nomination.  He was honoured by the Government of India with the Padma Shri in 2003 and the Padma Bhushan in 2010.

Mera Damad: Mera Damad is a 1985 family-drama Indian Hindi film directed by Partho Ghosh and produced by Shipra Biswas and Tushar Mazumdar.  It starred Utpal Dutt (in his final film appearance), Ashok Kumar, Farooq Sheikh, Zarina Wahab, Rakesh Bedi, Prema Narayan, and Jankidas in lead roles.  Music for the film was scored by Salil Choudhury and Babul Bose.>
